__comment: Trait definitions for procedural dwarf generation.
Traits are permanent attributes assigned at dwarf generation time.
They cannot be gained or lost during play.
Each trait has a polarity (positive / negative) and a rarity weight
used when the generator selects which specific trait to assign.
Trait effects are planned, not implemented; their design is in
Traits in the same exclusion group cannot be assigned to the same dwarf.
The generator checks exclusions before finalising each trait slot.
Weights for how many trait slots a dwarf receives at generation.
Rolls are weighted: total all weights, pick a random value, find the matching bucket.
When multiple slots are assigned, the generator fills positive slots from the
positive pool and negative slots from the negative pool independently.
'two_positive_one_negative' dwarves are the rarest and most valuable.

base:trait:born_miner.description: Tunnels feel like home. This dwarf reads rock grain by instinct — fewer wasted swings, richer finds.

base:trait:brewmasters_intuition.description: A nose for fermentation that cannot be taught. Their batches come out right even when everything else goes wrong.

base:trait:green_thumb.description: Plants seem to grow faster when this dwarf tends them. Even cave mushrooms respond.

base:trait:architects_eye.description: Everything they build sits true. Other dwarves bring their measurements to this one before they start.

base:trait:merchants_tongue.description: Caravans linger longer when this dwarf runs the shop. Something about the way they deal.

base:trait:warm_host.description: Travelers feel welcome the moment they step through the door. Guests always seem to stay one night longer.

base:trait:born_hauler.description: Has never dropped a load. Has never taken a wrong route. The colony runs on dwarves like this one.

base:trait:loves_to_cook.description: Happiest over a fire with a pot and an opinion. A Cook profession does not yet exist — but when it does, this dwarf was born for it.

traits.__comment_general_positive: General positive traits — personality and physical strengths.

base:trait:cheerful.description: Rarely has a bad day. The kind of dwarf whose mood is contagious in the best way.

base:trait:hardworking.description: Does everything a little faster. Not smarter — just more focused than most.

base:trait:iron_constitution.description: Shrugs off knocks that would put other dwarves in bed. Bruises faster than they slow down.

base:trait:deep_sleeper.description: Fully rested in five hours instead of six. Wakes ready to work before the torches are lit.

base:trait:iron_stomach.description: Content eating the same thing every day. Never complains about the menu.

base:trait:brave.description: Does not drop tasks when invaders are nearby. Keeps working while others run. Whether that is wisdom or stubbornness is debatable.

traits.__comment_negative: Negative traits — penalties, phobias, and difficult personalities.

base:trait:hates_the_outdoors.description: Uncomfortable under open sky. Outdoor tasks — farming, surface hauling, tending beehives — leave them unsettled and slow.

base:trait:cave_sick.description: Unsettled in sealed underground rooms with no view of the sky. Prefers open air — a difficult thing to find in a mountain colony.

base:trait:grumpy.description: Wakes up in a bad mood and works at it from there. Not unpleasant — just consistently underwhelmed.

base:trait:lazy.description: Not malicious — just unhurried. Every task takes a little longer than it should.

base:trait:light_sleeper.description: Needs seven in-game hours of sleep instead of the usual six.

base:trait:glutton.description: Eats considerably more than their share. Food stockpiles vanish faster with this dwarf around.

base:trait:alcohol_dependent.description: Must drink regularly or mood deteriorates fast. When supplied, the happiest dwarf in the colony. When the barrels run dry, the first to cause problems.

base:trait:loner.description: Prefers their own company. Thrives on solo mining assignments; struggles in a busy common room.

base:trait:fearful.description: Drops tasks and flees when an invader comes within range. Hard to rely on when the colony needs defenders.

base:trait:homesick.description: New arrivals sometimes carry the weight of wherever they came from. It fades — but it takes time.

base:trait:frail.description: Takes injuries more easily than most. One bad cave-in can put this dwarf out for a season.

base:trait:social.description: Mood lifts noticeably when working alongside others. Suffers quietly in solo assignments.
